note: Physical-validation run plan (docs/Physical_validation.md, TASK-066, TASK-068 D9). Offsets only, in metres from the site reference; no coordinates. Built into one spec.json per arm by pv_plan.py, which refuses a plan whose kangaroo leaves the fence less the orbit radius; flown in SITL with `python3 -m kangaroo_follow.demo --stage --plan --arm <id>`.

point.note: Flown first and held once for 45 s (one 70 m orbit at 25 m/s takes 17.6 s), at the fence's deepest point (68 m spare), away from the shared start; the kangaroo then walks to the shared start at the plan speed (an unscored transit). One lap of each run and no rests (author, 2026-10-10): every run starts and ends at the shared start, so the runs chain directly; 459 s (7.7 min) per arm, one battery per arm.

flight_card.note: Active only (HVAL_OUT 1), one arm across every run before the next arm. SCR_HEAP_SIZE: set the maximum of its range, 1048576 (1 MiB). Measured 2026-10-10 in SITL with both scripts (hardware_val.lua on HVAL_TGT 3 and kangaroo_source.lua) flying arm AH through the whole plan: peak 928 kB of a 1 MB heap, about 120 kB of headroom at the maximum. 0H and FH not yet measured in the two-script layout. Confirm on the board (SCR_DEBUG_OPTS 2) before flight; hardware_val.lua alone needed more than 692 kB on 2026-10-07, and Follow-03 flew in 350 kB.
